cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was working with the other pieces. You choose the angle; I'll take it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show me the move that beat me. I'll put that under your photo.
